children: COTI is set to introduce Interphase and COTI Global on 10 Oct 2026 as part of COTI 2.0. Interphase enables confidential, unlinked asset transfers across more than 30 major networks, while COTI Global is a central application for spending COTI as a privacy payment rail.

The products tie demand for COTI to two uses: confidential transfers across networks and everyday payments. Interphase provides the cross-chain privacy layer, while COTI Global provides the spending application. This connects the token's payment role with private asset movement across a broader network footprint. Actual adoption and usage remain unestablished, so the announcement does not demonstrate how much demand either product will generate.
COTI shifts into its next phase, with a new website to match.

title: COTI: Interphase and COTI Global launch for private transfers and payments - 10 Oct 2026
